content: FastAPI API-key auth: define api_key_header = APIKeyHeader(name='X-API-Key', auto_error=False) once, wrap validation in a dependency function that raises HTTPException(401/403) on mismatch. To retrofit onto an EXISTING app without touching each handler's signature, add the dependency at the APIRouter level (APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(verify_api_key)])) or at FastAPI(dependencies=[...]) app-level for blanket coverage, or per-router for a subset of routes (e.g. only mutating endpoints) — zero changes needed inside route bodies.
